name: research_knowledge_base
display_name: 深度检索知识库（子代理）
description: Launch a subagent to research the local knowledge base: it searches content and file names, reads full files, and returns a synthesized answer with source paths. Prefer this for complex or multi-step questions.

query.description: The question or keywords to research in the knowledge base.

max_results.description: Optional result limit per search round.
